notes: SOURCE STRUCTURE: The .docx contains NO real Word tables (zero w:tbl elements). The per-peak 'EDITION COMPARISION MATRIX' and 'ADD-ON SERVICE' grids were laid out visually and exported as a FLAT paragraph stream, so the original row/column grid cannot be losslessly reconstructed. Empty cells and vertically-merged cells produced NO paragraph, so most rows have FEWER than 5 cell values. Therefore each row is captured TWO ways: 'values' = the verbatim ordered paragraphs that fall between this row's feature/service label and the next one (lossless, but column position is NOT guaranteed to align to A-E), and 'cells' = a best-effort A/B/C/D/E mapping that is ONLY populated when a row retained exactly 5 values; otherwise 'cells' is null and you must read 'values' (which may also include wrapped sub-lines of a single cell, e.g. an address split across paragraphs). Column header order is identical in every matrix: A=Alpine(PURE), B=Bespoke(PERSONAL), C=Crafted(CURATED)★, D=Definitive(PREMIUM), E=Explorer(VISION); the C/Crafted column is marked with ★ as the 'curated standard'. ALL 13 peaks are present, each with one matrix + one add-on table. BASE PRICES: none exist. Every peak ends with 'Investment: From: $...........' placeholders only; no per-edition numeric base price is given. basePrices is therefore null for all editions/peaks. DOLLAR FIGURES that DO appear are inside cell text verbatim: add-on Sherpa prices like '1Sherpa $7000' / '1Sherpa $13000', Lhotse add-on climb '$24000' / 'Lhotse Climb $24000' (Everest & Lhotse only, 'Excl. Summit Bonus'), and Summit-Bonus/Tips amounts inside the 'Summit Bonus and Tips' feature row (e.g. Everest 'USD $ 2500 for lead guide, USD $1800 for each Sherpa', 'USD $600 Per Member'; Putha 'USD $1500/$1000', 'USD $400'). Prices appear as plain '$7000'/'$13000'/'$24000' style, NOT the '$13K/$24K' shorthand mentioned in the brief. SKI PEAKS: Putha Hiunchuli and Mera Peak include a 'Ski Descent' row in the matrix (values like 'Add on'/'Included'/'As required'); 'Ski Descent' also appears as an add-on row on several peaks. MLN ADD-ON ROW: on 5 peaks (manaslu, api-himal, baruntse, himlung-himal, chulu-far-east) the bold 'Mountain Lodges of Nepal (MLN)' add-on label was dropped in export; its row data (caption 'Comfort lodge upgrades along full trek route' + cells) was recovered from the block preamble and re-attached under that service label. 'editionHeaders' echoes the 5 edition column labels as they literally appear at the top of each matrix.
